defect: Process-wide hosted-authority postgres.js client (max: 1) parks its only connection and every later request hangs in the default composition.
engine: Lean default stack at port offset 1000 on source 588a301cfa9d3b961f75dd1374a099fc158fcd48: the real Supavisor transaction pooler (TLS verify-full) and the real migration image, run with the pooler probe's own sandboxed docker arguments on the installation network.
rootCause: postgres.js pipelines a root statement behind a busy one; Supavisor transaction mode never answers what is pipelined (upstream porsager/postgres#970). With max: 1 the client then waits forever.

driverMatrix.rounds: up to 5 rounds per shape, 8 s per round; the first non-ok ends the shape

max1.max_pipeline_0: error: begin never reserves its connection (porsager/postgres#1211)

driverMatrix.reserveTransactionsWithMaxPipeline0: sequential, concurrent-in-transaction, savepoint, 40 roots mixed with 4 transactions, and rollback on error: ok x5 at max 1 and at max 5

productBeforeAfter.harness: createPgAuthorityClient and transactPg imported from /app/src inside the migration image; AFTER bind-mounts the changed client.ts and tx.ts read-only over the image's copies

fix: 98f03b4f: the hosted client sets max_pipeline: 0 and replaces its own begin() with a reserved-connection transaction keeping Postgres.js's begin contract, so every caller (transactPg, the agent journal, apply-schema) is covered. The intermediate 3eee297a changed only transactPg and failed CI (other begin callers). The control-plane executor already avoids root pipelining (e9a95e35).
notProven: Hosted production on Supabase cloud; load beyond these shapes; the open upstream issues themselves.
